query_description: SELECT game_pk, season, batter_id + 21 aggregate cols FROM mlb_pitches JOIN mlb_games ON game_pk WHERE season=<S> AND game_type IN ('R','F','D','L','W') AND status_code='F' AND is_pitch=1 (2026 additionally official_date<='2026-07-27' per frozen contract) GROUP BY game_pk, season, batter_id

definitions.contact: swings - whiffs (foul/foul-tip/foul-bunt/in-play = contact; foul tips T/O counted as contact, not whiff)
definitions.zone: in-zone = zone BETWEEN 1 AND 9; out-of-zone = zone BETWEEN 11 AND 14; NULL zone excluded from both (era-absent pre-2008)
definitions.first_pitch: pitch_number=1; first_pitch_swings uses same swing set
definitions.inplay: is_in_play=1; launch mean/n/hardhit(>=95)/la_mean computed only over non-NULL launch fields among in-play rows

pitch_groups.denominator: pitches with non-empty pitch_type_code; pct NULL when denominator=0 (era-absent 2006-07 partial rollout)

definitions.null_policy: era-absent means/pcts emitted as \N (never imputed); count columns are explicit CASE-0/1 sums
definitions.grouping_note: FA merged into FF and ST/SV into SL per warehouse forensic report vocabulary guidance; E1 event not yet ledgered at build time - if E1 documented different group/denominator choices, reconcile before joint use
